model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: 2026 Audi Q4 e-tron Technical Specifications: Q4 45 e-tron (RWD) 180.7 in; Q4 55 e-tron quattro and Q4 Sportback 55 e-tron quattro 180.6 in. Columns are staggered in text extraction (sources/audi-2026-q4-e-tron-tech-specs.txt); each column read in row order.
length_in.discrepancy: C/D lists 180.7 in for its 2026 Premium Plus 55 quattro; Audi lists 180.6 in for the 55 quattro.

width_in.note: 'Overall Width without Mirrors' 73.4 in, all three versions; with mirrors 83.0 in.

awd.label: 55 e-tron quattro
awd.note: 'Driven Wheels': Rear-Wheel Drive (45) / All-Wheel Drive (55 quattro). C/D 2026 trims: Premium and Premium Plus in 45 RWD and 55 quattro. Sportback is a body variant filed under Q4 e-tron by Audi.

adapter.note: Audi NACS FAQ: 'The Q4 e-tron is subject to a future announcement. The Q4 e-tron is not currently able to utilize the Audi NACS DC adapter or any other NACS adapter.' Adapters go to Q6 e-tron, A6 Sportback e-tron and e-tron GT buyers.

charge_port.note: 'AC/DC Combo Port J1772 / CCS', 'Charge Port (Driver side)'.

us_status.note: Audi USA media has a 2026 Q4 e-tron press kit and 2026MY technical specs (rev. Aug 3, 2026). No explicit on-sale date.

epa_range.note: Both body styles (Q4 and Q4 Sportback 55 e-tron quattro) are rated 251 mi.

trims.note: Columns of the 2026MY technical specs (rev. Aug 3, 2026). Premium and Premium Plus trim levels (C/D) sit within each.

entries.note: 'Max Charging Capacity AC / DC: up to 11.5 kW / 175 kW'.
'28 minutes (10% - 80% charge @ 175 kW)'; footnote: 'Based on charging at a 175 kW or higher charger'.

MY2025 release in Audi's media API: 'A new Cold weather package ... is available on all Q4 55 e-tron trim levels and includes a heated windshield and heat pump.' Not confirmed for MY2026; the 2026 sheet doesn't mention it.
The MY2025 release names only the 55 e-tron.

cargo_cu_ft.note: 'Cargo Volume Trunk / With Seats Folded' 24.8 / 53.1 for the Q4 55 quattro (SUV). Sportback 55: 26.1 / 54.4 as extracted. Columns are staggered in the text layer; the SUV figures match C/D.

turning_circle_ft.note: 'Turning Circle (ft. Curb-to-Curb)': 37.7 for both 55 quattro versions; the RWD 45 reads 33.5 in the staggered text layer.

height_in.note: 'Height (in.)' 64.2 for the Q4 55 quattro (SUV); 64.7 for the RWD 45 and 63.5 for the Sportback, as extracted from staggered columns.

ground_clearance_in.note: 'Ground Clearance (in.)' 5.8 in every column, read from staggered columns; C/D lists NA, so there's no cross-check.

battery.text: Hybrid / Drive Battery: 8 Years / 100,000 Miles, 70% retention of battery capacity

warranty.note: Rows New Vehicle / Powertrain / Hybrid-Drive Battery, read from staggered columns; footnote 7 confirms the battery terms.

highway_tests.note: C/D 75-mph highway range test. Model year of the test car not stated on the page.

notes.text: Audi says the Q4 e-tron can't currently use any NACS adapter, so it has no Tesla Supercharger access for now.
Audi's 2026 sheet calls the 55 quattro's range 'EPA estimated' at 258 miles; EPA's own 2026 listing says 251. The pages use EPA's figure.
The heat pump statement is from the 2025 model year.
